query_verification.mode: real readonly SQL and deterministic tool scenarios

metrics.name: 点击/发送率
metrics.definition: clicked/sent，同一批次与观察窗口；零分母不计算

open_analysis_tool_report.sql: WITH windowed AS (SELECT *,sent_at + ? * interval '1 hour' horizon FROM metric_push_deliveries) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.clicked_at <= d.horizon AND (d.delivered_at IS NULL OR d.delivered_at>d.horizon) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_click_missing_delivery,SUM(CASE WHEN d.clicked_at <= d.horizon THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_clicked,COUNT(*) AS c_sent FROM windowed d WHERE d.sent_at >= ? AND d.sent_at < ? AND d.app_id IN (?) LIMIT 1001
limitations: 已确认到达率受回执覆盖影响；缺回执不等于失败。
比率按总分子/总分母计算，零分母不计算。
发送窗口与回执观察时长分别限定；不作因果归因。
解释为模型基于证据的分析，假设尚未验证；程序检查不证明业务因果。

answers.text: 已取得同口径两期证据，业务原因仍待验证
